title: ctlv: Prepare VA blob handling
overview: Adds the blob layer: a family callback can resolve a validated blob descriptor in the request into a pinned, CPU-accessible user buffer, read or write it by offset, and release it. blob.c sits on top of blob_desc.c (descriptor decode and check) and message.h (cursors, error offsets); internal.h gains the per-op state it needs, and the two public headers expose the family-facing API. The object is compile-checked on its own; device dispatch (patch 12) later sets the submitter and drives context init/finish.

files.purpose: Kbuild list for the ctlv module object.

units.title: Add blob.o to ctlv-y
units.summary: Links the new blob.o into the ctlv module (still unreachable until CONFIG_CTLV is wired up).

files.purpose: Implements task-bound VA blobs: pinning user pages for the duration of one op, copying to and from them, tracking them on the op context, and the exported resolve/read/write/put API used by families. Called from family callbacks (via the CTLV_IN_*BLOB helpers) and from the dispatch code through the context init/track/finish hooks.

units.title: Header, includes
units.summary: License, file comment (backing is acquired lazily in the submitting task and held until put) and includes.

units.title: struct ctlv_blob
units.summary: One resolved blob: length, direction, type, owning op context and list linkage, plus a union of per-type backing state.
units.details:
- Only the `va` member exists so far: the `mm` that was grabbed, the pinned `pages` array and count, and `start`, the offset of the buffer within its first page.
- `ctx` is NULL once the blob has been untracked.

units.title: Direction and liveness predicates
units.summary: Small checks: readable unless output-only, writable unless input-only, and access allowed only from the submitting task while the op's blobs are live.
units.details: `ctlv_blob_same_task()` treats a missing ctx or submitter as unconstrained; `ctlv_blob_access_live()` additionally requires `ctx->blobs_live`, which `ctlv_blob_context_finish()` clears.

units.title: ctlv_blob_pin_charge()
units.summary: Charges the pages to the mm's `pinned_vm` against RLIMIT_MEMLOCK, bypassed by CAP_IPC_LOCK.
units.details: The pin is short-lived (one op), hence not FOLL_LONGTERM. On refusal the charge is rolled back and -ENOMEM returned. Undone in `ctlv_blob_va_release()` or the acquire error path.

units.title: ctlv_blob_va_range()
units.summary: Converts a user address and length into the first page address and page count, with overflow and TASK_SIZE checks.
units.details: Rejects zero length (-EINVAL) and ranges that wrap, exceed TASK_SIZE, or would make the page-pointer array size overflow (-EFAULT). Runs before anything is charged or allocated.

units.title: ctlv_blob_va_acquire() - sizing, charge
units.summary: First phase of pinning a VA blob: compute the range, allocate the page array, pick FOLL_WRITE and charge RLIMIT_MEMLOCK.
units.details: Writable blobs (output or inout) pin with `FOLL_WRITE`. The page array is accounted with `GFP_KERNEL_ACCOUNT`.

units.title: ctlv_blob_va_acquire() - pin and commit
units.summary: Pins pages in INT_MAX-bounded batches, then publishes the state into the blob and grabs the mm; error labels unwind pins, charge and array.
units.details:
- A short pin counts as progress; zero or negative stops the loop.
- `mmgrab(current->mm)` keeps the mm_struct alive so the later unpin and uncharge are safe even if the submitter exits.
- `err_unpin` releases only the pages actually pinned but returns the whole charge.

units.title: ctlv_blob_va_release() and ctlv_blob_va_copy()
units.summary: Release unpins (dirtying if writable), uncharges, frees the array and drops the mm; copy walks the pinned pages with memcpy_to/from_page.
units.details: `ctlv_blob_va_copy()` assumes the range has already been checked by `ctlv_blob_range_ok()`; it starts at `va.start + offset` and moves page by page.

units.title: ctlv_blob_len()
units.summary: Exported accessor for the blob length.

units.title: ctlv_blob_range_ok()
units.summary: Checks that an access matches the blob's direction, happens in the submitting task while live, and lies within the length.
units.details: Each failure is a WARN_ON_ONCE, since direction, length and offsets are the family's responsibility rather than the caller's.

units.title: ctlv_blob_copy(), ctlv_blob_read(), ctlv_blob_write()
units.summary: Common checked copy dispatched on blob type, with exported read and write wrappers.
units.details: Zero-length copies succeed after the check. Only `CTLV_BLOB_TYPE_VA` is handled; other types return -EINVAL. `ctlv_blob_write()` casts away const for the shared helper.

units.title: ctlv_blob_put()
units.summary: Releases a blob: type-specific release, unlink from the op context, free.
units.details: NULL is accepted. Must run in the submitting task. Also used by `ctlv_blob_context_finish()` for blobs the family forgot to put.

units.title: Context init, track, finish
units.summary: Per-op bookkeeping: init the blob list and flags, add a resolved blob to the list, and at op end mark blobs dead and release leftovers.
units.details:
- `finish()` clears `blobs_live` first; leftover blobs are a warning and set `blob_error` to -EINVAL if none was set, then are put.
- Returns `ctx->blob_error` for dispatch to fold into the op result.
- Called around the op callback in device dispatch (patch 12).

units.title: ctlv_blob_context_fail()
units.summary: Records, if no error is set yet, a BAD_BLOB_DESCRIPTOR validation error pointing at the attribute and its parent.
units.details: Offsets come from `ctlv_message_offset()` on the cursor, matching what schema validation would have reported.

units.title: ctlv_blob_acquire()
units.summary: Allocates a blob from a decoded descriptor and pins its VA backing.
units.details: Reads address, length and type from the descriptor members. The type switch is not yet consulted: it always calls `ctlv_blob_va_acquire()`. Frees the blob on failure.

units.title: ctlv_blob_resolve()
units.summary: Exported entry used by the generated resolve helpers: verifies the cursor, schema node and calling task, re-decodes the descriptor, acquires and tracks the blob.
units.details:
- Preconditions (cursor belongs to `ctx->request`, node is a blob, caller is the submitter with blobs live, descriptor already passed validation) are WARN_ON_ONCE checks returning -EINVAL.
- Direction comes from the schema node.
- On acquire failure the context error is filled via `ctlv_blob_context_fail()`; on success the blob is tracked on the op.

files.purpose: Core-internal interface of blob.c used by the dispatch code: per-op context init, tracking and finish.

units.title: Context hooks
units.summary: Declares `ctlv_blob_context_init/track/finish`, with opaque forward declarations of the blob and op context.

files.purpose: Private core definitions shared by the ctlv .c files, notably `struct ctlv_op_ctx`, the per-execution state.

units.title: Includes and task_struct forward declaration
units.summary: Adds linux/list.h and a forward declaration of `struct task_struct` for the new ctx fields.

units.title: op_ctx: submitter
units.summary: Adds `submitter`, the task that submitted the op, used only for identity comparison against `current`.
units.details: It is const and never dereferenced, so it holds no reference. Set by dispatch (patch 12); checked by the blob code.

units.title: op_ctx: blob list and state
units.summary: Adds the list of live blobs, the `blobs_live` flag and the sticky `blob_error`.

files.purpose: Public API header for CTLV families; this patch adds the blob accessors usable from family callbacks.

units.title: ctlv_blob_put() and ctlv_blob_len()
units.summary: Opaque `struct ctlv_blob` and kernel-doc for releasing a blob and reading its length.

units.title: ctlv_blob_read() and ctlv_blob_write()
units.summary: Kernel-doc and prototypes for offset-based copies out of an input blob and into an output blob.

files.purpose: Header for family implementers: builder/cursor helpers and macros that generated family headers instantiate. This patch adds blob resolve helpers.

units.title: ctlv_blob_resolve() declaration
units.summary: Declares the core resolver that the generated helpers call.

units.title: CTLV_IN_BLOB()
units.summary: Generates `<name>_resolve(ctx, nest)` for a named blob attribute inside a nest.
units.details: Locates the attribute with `ctlv_input_attr()` and `<name>_ref()`, then calls `ctlv_blob_resolve()`. Used by generated headers, e.g. the attestation evidence blob.

units.title: CTLV_IN_EACH_BLOB()
units.summary: Generates `<name>_resolve(ctx, attr)` for a cursor already positioned on an element of a repeated blob attribute.
units.details: Returns ERR_PTR(-EINVAL) if the cursor is not at that attribute.
